tiberius-succeeds-augustus.description: An oil-painting style interior of a stone hall with arches and wall torches. In the foreground a stern, middle-aged man with short greying hair wears a golden-ochre toga with purple stripe over a white tunic, one hand resting on a stone balustrade. Behind him on the right is a white marble bust of a laurel-wreathed man in a toga. Behind the balustrade, rows of togate men in tiers raise their arms and seem to shout or cheer. No visible text, frame or border; the painting fills the image edge to edge.

claudius-raised-by-praetorians.description: A Roman soldier in a crested helmet and scale armour and red-trimmed cloak grips a heavy dark patterned curtain in a marble palace hall. Behind it, an older, thin, grey-haired man in a cream tunic cowers against a wall with a wide-eyed frightened look and one hand raised. A second helmeted soldier stands in the background shadows, and the floor is a patterned mosaic. The painting fills the frame edge to edge with no visible text.

vespasian-proclaimed-emperor.description: A laurel-crowned, heavy-set older man in red cloak and segmented armour stands barefoot-sandalled on a large bronze shield, held aloft by cheering helmeted legionaries. Behind them are tents, campfires, smoke-darkened sky, and tall gold eagle standards and a round-disc standard. The painted style is an oil-painting look; no text is visible, and the image fills its frame edge to edge.

titus-becomes-emperor.description: A bearded man in a gold laurel wreath and gilded armour under a deep red cloak raises one hand toward a crowd in a city street. Behind him rises a large, partly scaffolded stone amphitheatre with arches, and scaffolding and a smoking brazier stand nearby. Soldiers in plumed helmets and togas-wearing onlookers fill the scene, under an overcast sky. No visible text, border or frame; the painting is edge to edge.

commodus-becomes-emperor.description: A young man with curly dark hair stands centre frame in a lion-skin cloak with the lion's head on his shoulder, holding a wooden club and raising one hand. Armoured soldiers with raised arms and helmets surround him, with a fire burning at lower left, torches and a banner at top right, and a dark forest behind. The painting fills the whole image edge to edge with no frame or text.

septimius-severus-seizes-throne.description: A bearded man with a laurel wreath and dark curls rides a black horse at the front of a column of armored soldiers in red capes and helmets. He wears a silver cuirass over a red tunic. Behind him is a stone archway and a city with classical temple buildings under smoky, orange-lit skies, with red standards and spears raised. The painting fills the frame edge to edge in a dramatic oil style. No visible text.

caracalla-sole-emperor.description: A dark-haired, bearded man with a stern scowl stands in a dim marble hall, wearing a red cloak over dark metal armour with a short dagger at his waist. Behind him to the right is a round gold-framed painted panel showing a bearded older man, a woman with pale hair, and a boy, with one figure's face scraped and splintered away. Ornate columns, arches, a carved stone pedestal and a candle sconce fill the background. No visible text.

elagabalus-becomes-emperor.description: A young man in ornate gold-and-crimson embroidered robes and a tall jeweled headdress raises one hand in front of a large black conical stone on a gold chariot pulled by black horses. Behind him, armoured Roman soldiers with spears and a crested helmet stand near burning torches, with eagle standards, smoke, fire and classical stone buildings in the background. No visible text, frame or border; the painting fills the image edge to edge.

aurelian-becomes-emperor.description: A man with a laurel wreath and segmented metal armour and a red tunic stands on a wooden platform, pointing forward. Behind him, mounted soldiers in helmets and crested helmets stand among horses. In the background, a tall brick fortress wall with towers, scaffolding and cranes, with smoke drifting over it. No visible text, frame or border.

diocletian-becomes-emperor.description: A bearded man with grey hair, wearing a silver cuirass, a purple cloak and a sword, stands on a wooden platform with one arm raised. Around him, helmeted soldiers hold long spears and torches in front of dark military tents and red-and-black banners under a smoky, stormy sky. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text.

constantine-hailed-emperor.description: A dark, painted scene: a clean-shaven young man in a red cloak and metal chest armour is lifted high on the shoulders of soldiers, one arm raised. The soldiers wear mail and helmets and carry round shields with a painted bird-like emblem, and one holds a gold standard. Behind them are stone walls, towers, a wooden scaffold and rolling hills under a stormy sky. No visible text.

julian-apostate-sole-emperor.description: A bearded man with a gold laurel wreath and a dark cloak stands at a stone altar, sprinkling or offering something from his hands over a bowl. Smoke and flames rise from a brazier at the right. Behind him are large marble statues of a bearded god and a helmeted goddess holding a spear, and a torch burns on the left beside a relief-carved column. The scene is dim and lit by firelight, with no visible text, frame or border.

theodosius-i-becomes-emperor.description: A kneeling man in dark Roman-style armour and a black cloak, with a gold diadem on his head, while a crowned man in purple and gold robes lays a hand on his head. Armoured soldiers with helmets and spears stand behind them in a torch-lit stone hall with arches and columns. No visible text, frame or graphic content.

romulus-augustulus-emperor.description: A young boy wearing a jeweled gold crown and a purple and gold embroidered robe sits on an ornate grey marble throne in a dim hall with candles and columns. A man in dark lamellar armour and a brown cloak stands behind the throne with his hand on its back. Several figures in shadow line the background. The painting fills the whole frame, with no visible border, text or signature.

heraclius-becomes-emperor.description: A bearded man in scale armour and a red cloak stands at the prow of a dark wooden galley, holding a gold icon of a Madonna and child. Oarsmen and spearmen crowd the boat behind him, with lanterns glowing. Ahead, a fleet of sailing ships moves across rough grey water toward a walled fortress with tall towers, where fires burn on the battlements under a stormy sky. A small mark sits in the bottom-right corner.

leo-iii-becomes-emperor.description: A bearded man in scale armour and a metal helmet with a purple cloak and red undertunic grips a sword hilt beside a stone wall. Behind him, soldiers with shields and spears stand near a siege engine. Beyond the wall, small sailing ships sit on a sea at sunset under dark clouds. No visible text, border or frame; painterly oil style.

irene-sole-ruler-byzantium.description: A woman in a jewelled crown with a cross and pearl veil sits alone on a gold-and-red jewelled throne, holding a sceptre in her right hand and a golden orb with a cross in her left. She wears an ornate embroidered gold and jewel-studded robe. Around her, men in dark robes kneel and bow with their heads down, and armoured guards with spears stand in the background. The setting is a dim vaulted hall with gilded mosaic arches, stone columns and lit torches. No text, numbers or frame are visible.

basil-i-founds-macedonian-dynasty.description: A bearded, muscular man in a red and gold embroidered imperial robe stands in a dim church while a bearded cleric in black vestments with gold trim sets a jeweled crown on his head. Behind them are gold icons, lit candles, a column and incense smoke, with a light shaft from a high window. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text.

basil-ii-becomes-emperor.description: A young man with a jeweled crown and dark hair stands in armour with a gold-trimmed purple cape and a sword at his hip, beside a gilded ornate throne. Behind him in a candlelit hall with arched stone walls, bearded clergy swing a smoking incense censer, and armoured guards with spears stand in the shadows. Gold mosaic and lit candles fill the background. No text, frame or border is visible.

alexios-komnenos-seizes-power.description: A mounted knight in a red cloak and chainmail raises a mace on a dark horse, in front of a stone fortification with its wooden gate doors thrown open. Smoke fills the dark sky with an orange glow on the left. Armoured soldiers with round shields, axes and spears crowd around him, and a helmeted man with an axe is in the lower right foreground. No visible text, border or frame; the painting runs edge to edge. No visible blood or gore.

michael-viii-palaiologos-crowned.description: A bearded man in a jewelled crown and red and gold robes sits on a large round silver shield, held up by armoured soldiers in mail and helmets, while a second man in a gold cloak stands behind him. A crowd of spearmen, torch-bearers and clergy in black and gold fills a stone courtyard under a dark sky, with a small boy in a purple gold-trimmed robe standing at right. The architecture shows domes and arched stone walls, and the whole scene is an oil-style painting edge to edge with no visible text or frame.

constantine-xi-last-emperor.description: A bearded man in a jeweled crown, red and gold robe with double-headed eagles and a torn dark cloak holds a sword while standing on a ruined brick and stone battlement. Behind him is a dusky domed city with smoke rising and a dark army at the right edge. Oil-painting style, no text, no frame, no gore.
